name: 3S Viking Sea
author: Joakim
description: The fleet's world, carved out of the Viking status panel per the three-way split: Sea (live voyage status, the chart with click-to-queue courses, resolve options, saga), Voyage (boons/aids/goods/curios), Map (the territory grid with click-to-travel and vikloc naming) and Travel (clickable settlement list). Fed by the Guild.Voyage / Guild.Map / Guild.Fleet / Guild.Settlement GMCP packages (3Scapes only). Includes the vnav auto sea-navigation: tours charted islands/wrecks/objectives nearest-first and auto-resolves nodes by your preference list with hull/supplies conditions. Town travel routes through 3s-viking-status-gmcp (it owns vgo/vhere and the route engine) - load both. Map terrain and chart-row field shapes are marked VERIFY LIVE where the 27 Aug capture never carried them.
